tool.name: Create View
tool.description: Create a new generative view from a USE JSON document. The view becomes visible in Create > Views and renders as real SwiftUI.

ai.systemPromptSection:
### create_view
Create a generative view from a USE JSON document. Call get_view_catalog first to learn valid components and actions.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"create_view","query":"{\"name\":\"Counter\",\"document\":{\"component\":\"vstack\",\"props\":{\"spacing\":16},\"children\":[{\"component\":\"text\",\"props\":{\"content\":\"Hello\"}}]}}"}
```

The document is validated before saving; on failure you get actionable errors. Interactive state uses 'stateKey' props and actions like setState/toggleState/incrementState.
whenToUse: User asks for a new in-app view, widget, dashboard, form, or mini-app
Building UI the user can open later from Create > Views
whenNotToUse: Producing code artifacts or files (use artifact tools)
